scope.goal: Specify, generate and independently install the entire native-Go FCIS Instruction System with no preexisting Fountain Coach runtime, including secure first-owner bootstrap, native FountainStore and SecretStore, OAuth/WebAuthn, MCP, typed Host/MIDI2 instrument registry, FCIS Skills/scenario learning, existing Fountain Press Access UX and independent release lifecycle. Optionally adopt an existing installation with separate continuity verification.
included: Native-Go issuer, OAuth, WebAuthn, MCP and owner/Host wire surfaces
Self-contained Go-native FountainStore and Go-native encrypted SecretStore
Fresh-install initialization, first-owner bootstrap, recovery and upgrade lifecycle
Existing Fountain Press owner UI and issuer login/pairing UX as bundled frontend
Native software Host with read-only capability and optional external MIDI2 adapters
Versioned capability inventory, instrument admissions, client-scoped grants and terminal receipts
FCIS-KIT skills, scenarios, learning, version promotion and customer-owned derived work
Provider-neutral subscription-only model client adapters and actual supported customer account selection; zero additional inference charges
One-instance customer/owner model with tenant-ready namespaces and portable Store export
Reproducible immutable generation, offline CI, release, backup/restore and rollback
Optional source-bound legacy migration including the existing Hetzner instance

Owner-private Skill authoring and signed revision management through the existing Go Admin API, with independent commercial catalogue, acquisition, entitlements and licensed source delivery specified for priority two.
Owner-private native chat and provider-independent conversation continuity with subscription-only reasoning, external MCP integration and FCIS-CHAT-01 acceptance.

Optional domain-bound reasoning composing existing Skills, authoritative knowledge, Instruments, domain-owned Grounding and transient Situation; reference subcase of FCIS-CHAT-01, not an additional P0 prerequisite.
excludedFromFirstRelease: commercial Stripe billing adapter (versioned optional integration only)
production deployment or migration automatically implied by a source commit
Commercial distribution, customer admission beyond the initial owner, and payment-enabled acquisition are priority two; no additional first-release or P0 prerequisite.

designPrinciple.name: Voraussetzungslos
designPrinciple.rule: The FCIS system must be fully specified and reproducibly generated from this composition without requiring any preexisting FCIS instance, owner, Host, Keychain, FountainStore, SecretStore, Go service, GitHub connection, MIDI2 device, Hetzner machine, reverse proxy or AI-provider account.

designPrinciple.externalProviderPolicy: external models, payment providers, MIDI2 hardware, Git servers and deployment targets are optional adapters; unavailable adapters cannot prevent the core system starting
designPrinciple.nonAssumption: Any name, address, credential, grant, source repository or hostname discovered in an existing installation is instance input, not an architectural precondition
designPrinciple.securityBoundary: Voraussetzungslos does NOT permit self-authorizing an already claimed owner, bypassing WebAuthn, manufacturing grants or escaping verified custody during optional migration

setupTicket.concurrentClaim: exactly one compare-and-swap transaction; loser receives 409
setupTicket.consumption: atomic with first owner public credential and trust-root publication
setupTicket.onExpiry: owner can issue a new ticket only via local operator command while ownerCount=0 and no credential exists

records.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, versioned typed record for each collection
records.keyEncoding: tenantID + NUL + collection + NUL + canonical opaque id
records.unknownFields: reject unless record type explicitly declares extensions
records.schemaEvolution: pure versioned migration functions, backups and old snapshot readback before activation

wal.file: wal-0000000000000001.log with monotonically numbered rotated segments

payload.operations: bounded array of typed put/delete; one entire transaction per durable frame
payload.canonicalization: keys sorted by tenant, collection and id and stable JSON encoder; duplicate key in same transaction rejected

frame.checks: version, sequence continuity, payload bounds, CRC32C; missing/truncated final frame ignored only if uncommitted, corruption in complete/middle frame LOCKED

wal.commit: serialize transactions under exclusive writer lock; append full frame, fsync WAL, update memory and only then acknowledge success
wal.replay: load verified immutable snapshot then replay complete frames with sequence > snapshot sequence, preserving deduplication via transactionID
wal.rotation: cut only after fsynced snapshot and manifest commit

snapshot.format: versioned canonical JSON map of collection/key/value, gzip optional
snapshot.commit: write file+fsync, atomic rename, fsync parent; then atomic manifest update
snapshot.corruption: LOCKED, refuse authority reads rather than fall back to empty

manifest.atomicReplace: write temp, fsync temp, rename, fsync parent directory
manifest.backup: use verified manifest plus all referenced snapshot and WAL files; never copy inconsistent live directories

transactions.isolation: serialized single writer; consistent snapshot readers pinned to sequence
transactions.cas: expected revision/sequence required for owner changes, grants, revocations and refresh rotation
transactions.refusal: no partial security effects or positive HTTP response on WAL fsync failure

recovery.startup: verify root owner/mode, manifest/hash, WAL and vault binding before serving protected routes
recovery.rollback: never lose or resurrect a previously committed revocation or refresh-family spend
recovery.compaction: may remove WAL segments only when covered by verified snapshot and recovery/backup retention boundaries

ownerAndTenancy.initialMode: one unclaimed installation, one initial owner, single default tenant created at claim

No metered inference, Workspace Agent credits/trigger lane, recharge, paid fallback, or billing mutation. Unknown/exhausted/unsupported refuses; deterministic tasks and conversation history need no model account.

ownerAndTenancy.sharing: Tenant explicitly approves signed offers for exact admitted revisions with rights, terms and price; private source stays private, approved metadata only is listed; client delivery requires current resource consent and exact entitlement. Git and providers optional.
ownerAndTenancy.billing: Optional phase-two payment instrument; customer acquisition/entitlement must reconcile exact verified terminal receipts for paid offers; startup and core usage never require Stripe.

The system retains evidence, constraints and bounded counterexamples, or settles no-lesson/insufficient-evidence/pending without invented success.
skillAndScenarioSystem.promotion: owner/tenant policy controls explicit signed version promotion, immutable release manifest and independent terminal evidence; a model cannot self-admit a proposed Skill
skillAndScenarioSystem.recovery: Skill revision and scenario provenance persist in tenant Store and signed export; Git is a synchronized publication copy, not a required operational database
skillAndScenarioSystem.privacy: tenant scenario data never becomes shared training or globally published Skill automatically
skillAndScenarioSystem.rights: tenant/user-authored derived skills retain their chosen rights; source owner's existing license is not overwritten

distribution.decision: FountainStore canonical private custody; FCIS API primary distribution authority; GitHub/ChatGPT optional explicitly approved adapters. Existing FCIS-GO public projection unchanged.
distribution.ownerProfile: Version 2 signed Skill admission is only current single owner/default tenant; admin operations derive actor/tenant from authorized session, no caller-selected tenant. Reject unavailable additional tenant admission/signing; commercial customer flow requires separately admitted customer principal and grant, not owner session impersonation. Current version-2 CLI admission is retained and does not require a pre-existing browser draft; the new browser admission must verify the referenced reviewed draft. Existing admitted private v2 releases are readable without manufactured draft history.
distribution.security: Owner writes require exact same-origin session, specific X-Fountain-Owner-Intent and explicit confirmation; signed admission and offer use existing trusted owner signer, exact immutable bytes. No new signer, public write route, bearer fallback or arbitrary tenant ID. Reject unknown fields, duplicate keys, wrong signatures and oversized decoded inputs.
distribution.clientResource: The existing issuer uses OAuth authorization code PKCE S256, explicit client/resource/scope consent, and durable revocable grants. The compatibility resource {issuerOrigin}/oauth/skills keeps exact independent skills.owned.read (owner) or skills.read or skills.acquire (commercial) scopes; no token for /mcp may be replayed there. Commercial operations remain separate and derive the customer identity server-side; no owner grant becomes a customer licence. The single external owner bridge is {issuerOrigin}/mcp: explicit skills.owned.read consent for the current owner’s active library including future active revisions may coexist with independently approved, actually admitted instrument scopes on the same /mcp grant. No wildcard, automatic widening, commercial scope, cross-audience token exchange or owner-cookie forwarding. Skill reads require skills.owned.read and owner/tenant/client binding; Host operations require their own effective scope and admission. Inspect and revoke through existing management; revalidate on every protected call and refresh, including active pointer, exact signature and independent redacted durable receipt before source delivery; no drafts or history. Existing grants and the Skill-only compatibility resource remain valid until proven replacement and deliberate retirement. Actual client verification and use remain separate. For the existing /mcp bridge, sanitized generic Skill Access tool schemas are reviewable by a valid current /mcp participant with at least one effective admitted scope, before granting the specific Skill scope. This is definition discovery only: no private Skill identity, source, release, receipt, grant, or actual callable authority. Anonymous, invalid, wrong-audience, expired or revoked discovery remains refused. Calling a known Skill tool without its required scope returns an exact resource-bound insufficient_scope authentication challenge; any new permission requires explicit consent. Keep /oauth/skills discovery and all data/dispatch checks unchanged. External definitions must honestly disclose operation effects, closed typed input schemas and required OAuth scopes; no generic arbitrary-operation executor or concealed review bypass. Internal implementations may evolve behind the same reviewed contract; genuinely new or materially changed external operations use the provider's supported metadata update/review process. FCIS marketplace acquisition, payment and licence administration stay outside the ChatGPT bridge; later eligible licensed consumption is separate from owner rights and requires independent entitlement and consent. No automatic review approval, new grant, customer admission, purchase or public publication is established.
distribution.transactions: Tenant+actor+operation+idempotencyKey binds canonical request digest. Identical replay returns original receipt/status; changed payload returns 409; re-evaluate current access before disclosing protected replay. Compare expected revisions; no duplicate mutations or charge. Atomic immutable revisions, active pointers, offer/entitlement states and receipts. No source bytes in telemetry; authenticated responses and refusals no-store. For draft create receipt.subjectId is the draftId; for admission it is releaseId; for offer release it is offerId; for review/withdraw/revoke it is the changed object's exact ID. recordRevision is that object's committed revision. A verified receipt remains independently readable via the corresponding protected resource, with audit references.
distribution.commercial: Phase two, not first release or P0 prerequisite. Price and terms immutable per offer; new price requires new signed offer. Zero-price offers require explicit terms acceptance; paid entitlement only after verified instrument terminal receipt exact amount, currency, customer, offer and acquisition. Provider checkout is hosted; no live charges authorized, no UI redirect proof. Refunds are separate approved instrument actions, entitlement changes only under accepted terms and reconciled receipts. Unlisted is non-enumerated metadata, not a confidentiality or access grant; customer may inspect an exact known offer before accepting terms. Restricted bespoke audience/recurring or metered plans require a later explicit contract; this version supports one-time exact-release licensing only.
distribution.delivery: Only exact authorized source bytes and license are delivered, never public projection by default. No guarantee of provider installation, DRM or deletion of previously delivered copies. A client adapter may consume delivered instructions only with customer consent and separately proven supported integration. Tenant-derived knowledge remains customer-owned.
distribution.lifecycle: Draft -> verified evidence where applicable -> reviewed -> signed admitted revision; separate signed offer releases/withdrawals govern distribution, not source visibility. Restore is a fresh signed admission; withdrawal and entitlement revocation do not delete immutable history.
distribution.httpContract: FCIS-OPENAPI.json 0.8.0 defines owner management, explicitly consented active owner library reads, and separately licensed commercial distribution. Existing v1/v2 CLI signed custody remains compatible; added owner-client reads specified only. HTTP 0.8.1 adds the same-resource MCP projection of existing Skill Access read operations; no new grant or underlying operation. HTTP 0.9.3 adds the single owner bridge projection on the existing /mcp operation, preserving exact independent Skill/Host authorization and the old resource for compatibility. HTTP 0.9.7 specifies reviewable generic Skill definitions and a missing-scope challenge on the already authorized bridge, not pre-consent private data or calls.
distribution.collections: Existing native Store and its logical collections in persistence.skillCollections, one writer and verified readback. No new database, identity service, external marketplace or runtime prerequisite.
distribution.phases: Owner-private management first; commercial distribution and customer admission/payment priority two. No change to existing P0 owner-independence or first-install DoD.
distribution.ownerClientAcceptance: FCIS-SKILL-ACCESS-02: prove explicit owner consent, current resource-bound owner grant, unnamed active inventory, exact signed current read, redacted durable delivery receipt, refusal on wrong scope/audience/identity, stale pointer, draft/history, revocation and refresh denial after restart. Actual fresh authorized client verification and consumption are independent; founding gate remains inactive until owner acceptance. No provider billing. The supported MCP client must discover the two projected operations under the exact Skill audience and scope, receive matching verified UTF-8 source, exact signed bytes and durable delivery receipt, and independently prove actual use and refusal. No provider or Host authority inferred. FCIS-OWNER-BRIDGE-01: on the retained client identity and /mcp audience, explicit owner consent for selected admitted instrument scopes plus skills.owned.read allows current active inventory, signed release read and one real permitted instrument result, with independent Store receipts. Prove skill-only and instrument-only isolation, ungranted, expired/revoked, wrong-audience, stale and commercial refusals. No retirement until fresh real client use of both and owner acceptance. Transparent review continuation: a valid Host-only /mcp grant discovers both sanitized generic Skill definitions without retrieving private data or mutating Store; missing scope challenges; explicit mixed consent remains necessary; wrong audience and revoked/expired tokens refuse. Legacy Skill endpoint unchanged. Provider review and actual client use remain independent.

learningAcceptance.outcome: An independently accepted correction becomes a bounded private revision of an existing Skill; a distinct subsequent authorized reasoning invocation consumes that exact active revision and independently satisfies the predeclared comparable-task predicate without the owner repeating the correction.

stages.requirement: Select an existing Skill and actual authorized scenario. Bind its active signed R0 release and instructions digest to the original input/source revision, capability, run and independently witnessed deficiency and accepted correction. Before drafting, fix the observable subsequent-task predicate and comparable input boundary. Retain the original terminal receipts and counterexamples; an invalidated attempt is negative evidence only.

Extract the non-trivial reusable trigger, exact bounded procedure, constraints, stop conditions and counterexamples from the accepted work. Create a private immutable draft for that existing Skill through the existing owner-authorized intent path. Bind the draft digest, provenance, owner/tenant and R0 predecessor to the accepted evidence. A reasoning model can propose but cannot review or self-admit.

Resolve actual independently accepted scenario evidence from existing execution, receipt, audit and domain-owned sources. Verify the same tenant, scenario, task/input/source/capability/run identities, terminal result, accepted correction and exact draft binding. Use scenario-verified review, not a source-review substitute. Persist the explicit owner decision and evidence references; rejected, unrelated, invalidated or unavailable evidence cannot promote the draft.

Require explicit existing owner approval and the established release signer; admit exact reviewed draft as private R1 with R0 as active predecessor. Verify signature, source digest, version, visibility, unchanged rights, immutable history and atomic active-pointer/receipt readback. CLI custody admission alone does not establish scenario review or learning. No execution grant, public publication or automatic promotion.

In a distinct actual supported reasoning-client invocation, select the applicable Skill by task and resolve the currently active R1 under existing authorized delivery. Independently verify manifest, signature, active identity and exact source digest; bind the delivered instruction bytes and their effective inclusion in the selected provider/client invocation before any governed work. Persist adapter-observed invocation/run and release/digest evidence; a model assertion, marketplace listing or cached historical source is insufficient. Revalidate capability authorization independently before effects; refuse missing, unauthorized or stale required instructions. External reasoning must satisfy the mandatory subscription-only rule of reasoningAndConversationSystem before dispatch; otherwise refuse.

Run a new comparable task without repeating the lesson in its prompt, and independently witness the predeclared predicate and terminal result. Use a distinct run and comparable actual input, not a replayed test fixture or a result certified by the same validator. Correlate the baseline, accepted correction, proposal/review, signed R0/R1 chain, actual consumption, subsequent result and bounded negative witness; retain in existing tenant Store/evidence custody. Only the complete chain establishes LIVE-ACCEPTED learning.

evidence.requirement: Actual task and scenario identity, pinned input/source revision, R0 release/source digest, authorized capability and version, original run and terminal receipt, independently witnessed deficiency and accepted correction; subsequent predicate fixed before the change.

Existing Skill name and owner/tenant, exact immutable draft identity and source SHA-256, active predecessor R0, evidence references, reviewer decision and reason, verified scenario and correction binding.
Exact R0 and R1 identities and instruction digests, existing signer verification, version, privacy/rights, predecessor and independent committed active pointer and terminal receipt.

Actual selected provider/client identity, current authorized Skill delivery, R1 exact release/source digest, adapter-observed effective instruction inclusion bound to distinct invocation/request/run, before work, with no source content in public telemetry.

Distinct comparable real task/input revision, same predeclared observable predicate, independent outcome witness and terminal receipt, no owner restatement of learned procedure, linked negative/refusal evidence.

refusals.requirement: Missing, source-only, fabricated, invalidated, unrelated, mismatched or cross-tenant evidence must refuse scenario-verified review; keep active revision unchanged.
Unreviewed/rejected draft, stale predecessor, changed bytes, invalid signature, missing owner approval or automatic self-admission must refuse promotion; retain history and active pointer.
Absent/revoked authorization, unavailable or mismatched active revision, stale Git/cached copy, or unproved effective delivery must refuse governed work rather than silently substitute instructions.
Absent independent subsequent predicate/outcome, replayed fixture, repeated owner correction, model self-assertion or unlinked runs cannot establish learning acceptance.

Never disclose private source or tenant evidence via public Git, marketplace, unauthorized provider, or telemetry; never derive Host, provider, spend, commercial or publication authority from learning.

learningAcceptance.completion: A positive learning episode is LIVE-ACCEPTED only after all six stages and evidence/refusal obligations have independently read-back proof in a correlated two-attempt scenario. Continuous system behavior requires the additional general-acceptance requirements across distinct ordinary work episodes. Source schema, tests, Git merge, provider sync, standalone admission or a successful deterministic task are separate milestones; any missing predicate remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.
learningAcceptance.boundaries: Retain existing fcis.skills, Store collections and owner/client/Host/provider contracts. No new endpoint for the learning scenario itself, signer, database, permission system, marketplace Skill, automatic Git elevation, auto-admission or provider entitlement. This is a product acceptance gate, not a new first-install, P0 deterministic operation, or commercial prerequisite. Proposals and reviewed private learning remain distinct from suspended automatic promotion.

continuousBehavior.requirement: At ordinary admitted work-episode closure, not each tool invocation or chat message, resolve the owning scenario/task, tenant, actual input/source, participating clients and Voices, instruction releases, terminal receipts and independent outcome witness. Accepted, failed, cancelled, incomplete and unresolved are distinct; a low-level successful receipt alone is never acceptance.

Assessment is a default continuation of ordinary work, not a separately requested Skill maintenance task. Within the already authorized reasoning context evaluate whether an independently established outcome or correction is non-trivial, reusable and bounded; otherwise explicitly settle no-lesson, insufficient-evidence or assessment-pending. Unavailable reasoning leaves resumable pending state, never a fabricated lesson or a prerequisite for deterministic authorized work. No additional inference spend or provider entitlement.

Apply the same lifecycle to every participating admitted work/scenario domain and dynamically selected owned Skill, without a fixed Skill name, hard-coded correction, domain-specific keyword classifier or provider dependency. If no applicable existing Skill is established, retain a proposal for resolution under existing authority, never silently create an active identity.

Reasoning Voices may contribute observations, counterexamples, objections and a bounded proposed lesson through the existing independently addressable Voice plane. Preserve attribution and dissent, distinguish evidence from inference, and do not equate agreement, a contribution, or a model assertion with independent acceptance. Multiple model sessions are optional.

Use existing tenant-owned execution, conversation, scenario, receipt and Skill custody to bind one recoverable disposition to the exact work episode and active instruction baseline. Correlated retries resume the same assessment or proposal, do not duplicate effects, and resolve current state before continuing. Retain only the necessary private evidence/references, not wholesale conversation transcripts or external training data.

A reusable lesson is a bounded attributed proposal with a current Skill predecessor, independently witnessed evidence, constraints, counterexamples and a subsequent-task predicate. Use the existing authorized draft/review/admission path when its authority exists; otherwise retain an attributed private proposal, not an admitted revision. No reasoning client may impersonate owner intent, review itself, widen grants, or automatically publish/promote.

For each participating subsequent governed reasoning task, discover by task and consume the exact authorized current Skill release before work under the existing proven-client transition rule. Bind actual effective instruction inclusion and distinct invocation to later independently observed results; retrieval alone does not prove use. Preserve stale/refused/revoked handling and the existing founding transition.

Prove the default lifecycle on distinct ordinary actual work episodes in more than one admitted domain, including independently verified useful change and next-attempt improvement, no-lesson and insufficient-evidence outcomes, interruption/recovery without duplicate effects, stale/refused authority and unchanged unrelated Skills. A one-off manually requested revision, migration, isolated fixture, synthetic correction, or source gate does not establish continuous learning. The existing FCIS-LEARN-01 six-stage evidence chain applies to each positive learning case.

checks: JSON schema and required cross-component fields
Git blob digest and immutable source-reference binding

No generated Go system, no runtime tests, no verified deployed issuer, no existing-instance migration or production approval. Historical 0.4.0 baseline only; does not certify newly added 0.5.0 operations.

validationReceipt.limitations: No generated Go code, compile/test, live FCIS Host, server or production acceptance witnessed.

currentAdminAPI.status: local source consistency validation passed; protected CI acceptance recorded separately in reviewed PR

currentOwnerChat.scope: 0.7.0 existing owner conversation and subscription-only reasoning with optional situated domain context; no implementation or production claim
currentOwnerChat.status: private source candidate; prior validation receipts apply only to exact predecessors

sourcePinPolicy.immutable: Source checkout MUST verify exact Git blob SHA for every document before code generation; source revision may differ from composition commit; no branch ref or main may be substituted for required SHA
sourcePinPolicy.frontendPolicy: Preserve the existing pinned Press frontend as the baseline; owner-selected React Console target uses generated canonical OpenAPI bindings and static assets in the same Go executable. No live replacement until accepted.
sourcePinPolicy.derivedProtocolSchemas: The built-in native Go Store and vault formats are defined in this file and are not historical Swift-compatible by default

authorityNotice: Prerequisite-free FCIS normative source specification, validated by owner-owned CI at referenced commit; generated Go binaries, runtime tests and deployments are separately unverified.

reasoningAndConversationSystem.outcome: An owner can manage private conversations independently of model availability, select a genuinely supported subscription-only reasoning client, resume retained history with consent, inspect actual governed effects and retain independently witnessed learning evidence.

collections.requirement: Private owner/tenant record, title, lifecycle, selected client/model, ordered sequence head, active turn reference, revision, and timestamps. Stable owner-controlled identity independent of provider session.

Committed immutable ordered human and actual returned assistant text, exact conversation and turn references, source/provider provenance and linked receipt IDs. No hidden reasoning, raw credentials or fabricated responses. Per-message size within the native Store bound.

Distinct owner/tenant, exact committed human message, approved context and active signed Skill release IDs/digests, selected provider/client/model, consent and verified no-extra-charge evidence references, request/idempotency identity, state, actual returned message and independent instrument receipt links. Store metadata and content remain private. Optional domainContextBinding stores domain/Grounding references and verified context digest, not a persisted Situation projection.

requirements.requirement: Create, list, read, rename, archive, restore, export and explicitly delete conversations and committed ordered messages through existing tenant FountainStore, even with no external provider. Export through consistent scoped pages and existing protected Store export; never include credentials.

Verify actual current supported account/selected model, included allowance and provider-enforced refusal of additional charges before sending any native reasoning request. Local zero budget or provider login alone is not proof. Never separately meter, consume additional credits, recharge, switch automatically, purchase, or fall back.

The native FCIS plane MUST represent the LLM/reasoning runtime, each semantic voice, authorization, Composer and FountainStore persistence as governed MIDI2 instruments, discovered through MIDI-CI and communicating through typed UMP over admitted transports, including local software peers. Authorization is mandatory for protected effects; preserve existing owner, admission, consent and grant policy, and encapsulate OAuth/WebAuthn and provider-specific protocols behind the relevant instrument boundary. Existing external OAuth/PKCE and MCP are optional compatibility projections, not a native dependency or prerequisite to polyphony; expose only scoped instruments and retain existing permitted recovery paths until replacements are proven. Keep private Skill delivery individually authorized; the single external owner bridge on /mcp supports explicit Skill consent alongside independently granted admitted instruments. Preserve the separate /oauth/skills compatibility resource until replacement is proven. External model session initiation and complete chat history are not supplied by MCP. No owner-cookie transfer or invented token exchange. Owned active-library delivery requires explicit skills.owned.read on the request's exact approved resource; no drafts, history, licensed entitlement, or implicit Host scope. FCIS-POLYPHONY-01 uses Desktop Commander's demonstrated short-call, asynchronous-work, correlated progress/result and intervention interaction contract through the existing owned MIDI2 instruments. Each semantic voice MUST be a first-class, independently addressable MIDI2 instrument instance under the existing MIDI-CI discovery and typed MIDI2/FCIS-KIT invocation and lifecycle contract. An eligible ordinary external ChatGPT conversation can articulate several distinct voices without a native outbound inference adapter, Codex, Copilot or separate provider threads.

Support native FCIS Chat only through a provider-supported subscription account connection with actual returned response, independently verified included allowance and no-extra-charge behavior. Unsupported or unverified provider remains unavailable. Do not impersonate a browser session or revive the Workspace Agent trigger/credit lane.

Derive owner and tenant from authenticated session. Only real eligible client and model selection; persist selection without invoking. Explicit per-turn disclosure consent binds selected same-conversation ordered context and exact current signed Skill revisions. Revalidate scope, identity, selected model, active release and provider eligibility before external dispatch.

Commit human message and distinct turn request before dispatch with CAS/idempotency. Correlate selected provider, model, consent, exact context and Skill digest, and actual returned assistant message; verify Store readback. No blind retry after ambiguous dispatch. Provider status alone cannot establish completion. Cancellation distinguishes local stop from verified external cancellation.

Disconnect or change eligible reasoning client without losing owner conversation history, Skills or instrument receipts. Resume the same local conversation with the explicitly selected authorized context; no requirement to transfer a vendor session or import its complete transcript.

Keep execution permission independent of selected reasoning client. Link independently verified execution/receipt records to turns without converting model prose to execution evidence. Follow FCIS-LEARN-01 for private review, signed admission and subsequent real improvement. For discovery, use the existing fcis.receipts collection with actual observed profile/source/artifact, correlation, committed sequence and digest; verify independent readback and corresponding Console accessibility/reload. No reasoning turn or grant inferred. Agreement among same-model voices is not independent proof or a grant; actual instrument effects remain separately authorized and independently evidenced.

Owner-only private read/export/archive/delete with scoped same-origin authentication, cursor binding and no-store responses. Explicit deletion refuses unresolved turns, removes future content access, retains only required redacted independent evidence, and records deletion/tombstone across backup restore. Document actual backup retention and no claim of remote-provider erasure.

Existing React Console Chat and Integrations show current history, selected reasoning connection/model, actual availability, context consent, committed messages, evidence and learning links; native send unavailable when unsupported. Stable object selection after reload, sign-in and disconnect, accessible iPad list/detail. No second UI authority, service or Store. The Composer engraves participant identity, role, relation and actual outcome from the same typed evidence the agent reads; optional separate instrumentObservations on the existing reasoning-client page shows dated verified presence, not admission or eligible clients; absence stays unavailable. Accessible human and independently readable machine projections of one observation, with receipt details on demand, no raw telemetry or invented motion. FCIS-POLYPHONY-01: preserve distinct persistent personified voice identities and attributed contributions, replies, objections, revisions and linked actual evidence within a shared scenario; voice is independent of provider, model and thread. Its persistent instance identity is distinct from its capability version, transport address, provider session, contribution and execution; the Composer engraves the same authorized typed contributions and relations retained by FountainStore. Engrave the composition without prescribed workflow; presence need not consume inference. Composer exposes optional owner arrangement, selected immutable source references, persistent Voice presence, current admission decisions and independently read-back contributions; never implies consent or provider availability.

Public GitHub .github carries reviewed public behavior and protocol only. Existing authorized private implementation/tenant Store and SecretStore retain confidential material, private Skills, actual transcripts, evidence and credentials. Review exact disclosure and rights before public push; preserve explicit prior licences, customer rights and independent provenance. No new visibility change, rights assignment or blanket licence.

An optional domain is a source-owned immutable versioned declaration of applicable Skill identities and revision constraints, authoritative knowledge references and source owners, admitted Instrument/capability identities and version constraints, domain-owned Grounding schema and confirmation requirements, and acceptance scenario references. Resolve through existing authorized sources; no domain grants access, execution or entitlement. Do not introduce a new registry, engine, Store, provider or mandatory Reframe dependency.

Where the domain requires Grounding, resolve the exact confirmed semantic identity, owner, schema, source relationship, purpose, preservation duties and transformation constraints. Draft, contradictory, stale or missing required Grounding refuses affected interpretation. Revalidate source revisions; retain prior valid lineage and reuse only independently valid deterministic results. Null is valid only for a domain explicitly requiring none. Never silently truncate semantic obligations.

Derive the current arrangement and selected or wired objects from authorized authoritative application/domain state, not the transcript. Distinguish unwired, wired-empty, unselected and actually selected contexts; never invent scope or offer unavailable actions. Situation is transient, not a persisted fact or grant; retain only turn-bound domain/Grounding references and verified input digest, separate from source and execution evidence.

On the existing startOwnerReasoningTurn, validate optional situatedContext with exact domain and Grounding references, arrangement and selection; resolve current same-tenant knowledge/source identities and content digests, current active signed Skill release IDs/digests, selected ordered message identities/digests and eligible Instrument/capability versions within grants. Owner reviews this binding through existing authorized source projections. Recompute expectedContextSHA256 from canonical UTF-8 JSON (recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, preserved array order, exact string content; exclude digest itself) and compare before any disclosure. Persist domainContextBinding (domain, Grounding and actual digest), never the Situation projection. Revalidate current rights before each effect. Resume or change provider by re-resolving current inputs; retain previous lineage. No new HTTP operation, paid fallback or automatic provider selection.

refusals.requirement: Unverified, exhausted or revoked included entitlement, any possible additional inference charge or unsupported native transport refuses before outbound reasoning. No paid fallback or workspace billing mutation.

Foreign owner/tenant, wrong audience, absent context disclosure consent, stale/revoked Skill, missing grant, foreign or revoked voice instance, or unknown selected client/model refuses before disclosure or instrument execution.

Stale revision, changed idempotency input, duplicate dispatch, unresolved turn, unverified cancellation, duplicate voice contribution or absent actual answer cannot manufacture a completed response or additional execution.

No actual private conversation, private Skill payload, customer evidence, credentials or confidential implementation in public Git, marketplace, logs, public telemetry or unauthorized provider; do not infer entitlement from ownership.

Do not import external transcript automatically, present provider status or tool prose as an assistant answer, or label work learned without FCIS-LEARN-01 independent proof. Do not restore deleted content or resurrect revoked grants.

Refuse unavailable domain, unknown source or foreign reference, unconfirmed or stale required Grounding, stale arrangement/selection, unapproved resolved content, mismatched expected digest, invalid current Skill or capability scope before transmission or effect. No invented source fact or domain-wide permission; a previously committed historical answer retains its original lineage, not current validity.
